subject: Marine works - LNG Construction - Howe Sound
text:
Marine works - LNG Construction - Howe Sound
Construction of the Woodfibre LNG facility is taking place in Howe Sound at 49 39.909N 123 15.114W.
Two floating worker accommodation to support facility construction and commissioning of the Woodfibre LNG facility are at 49 39.650N 123 15.480W.
A Marine Safety Zone has been established around the work site.
All vessels not affiliated with the project are to avoid the Marine Safety Zone.
Operations are active 24 hours a day. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF channels 08 and 16.
 
 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-0315-26
